Option Explicit

' 通用示例模板：多维汇总工作簿（实测通过 0.73s）
'   建 3 张表(明细数据/汇总/校验) -> 6 个主体 × 6 期 × 4 指标 -> 格式/3色阶条件格式/自动筛选/冻结窗格
'   -> SUMIF 汇总块 -> 透视表(主体×期间=收入) -> 柱状图 -> 对账校验 -> 命名区域 -> 耗时写校验表
' 用法：内容先删掉所有 Attribute 行，再注入（run_vba.py 会自动剥），然后 Application.Run "BuildSummaryReport"
Sub BuildSummaryReport()
    Dim t0 As Double, LOGPATH As String
    t0 = Timer
    LOGPATH = Environ$("TEMP") & "\vba_report.log"
    Application.ScreenUpdating = False
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    Application.Calculation = xlCalculationManual

    Dim wsD As Worksheet, wsS As Worksheet, wsC As Worksheet
    Dim nm As Variant
    For Each nm In Array("明细数据", "汇总", "校验")
        On Error Resume Next
        ThisWorkbook.Worksheets(CStr(nm)).Delete
        On Error GoTo EH
    Next nm

    Set wsD = ThisWorkbook.Worksheets.Add
    wsD.Name = "明细数据"
    Set wsS = ThisWorkbook.Worksheets.Add
    wsS.Name = "汇总"
    Set wsC = ThisWorkbook.Worksheets.Add
    wsC.Name = "校验"

    ' ---- 1) 造数（把主体/期间/指标换成你的口径即可）----
    Dim companies As Variant, periods As Variant, head As Variant
    companies = Array("主体A", "主体B", "主体C", "主体D", "主体E", "主体F")
    periods = Array("2023H1", "2023H2", "2024H1", "2024H2", "2025H1", "2025H2")
    head = Array("主体", "期间", "营业收入(百万元)", "毛利率", "净利润(百万元)", "销量(万千升)")
    Dim i As Long, j As Long, r As Long
    Dim base As Double, rev As Double, gm As Double, npf As Double, vol As Double
    For i = 0 To UBound(head)
        wsD.Cells(1, i + 1).Value = head(i)
    Next i
    r = 1
    For i = 0 To UBound(companies)
        base = 8000# + i * 3500#
        For j = 0 To UBound(periods)
            r = r + 1
            rev = base * (1 + 0.012 * j) * (1 + 0.03 * ((i Mod 3) - 1))
            gm = 0.38 + 0.01 * i - 0.004 * j
            npf = rev * (gm - 0.22)
            vol = rev / (4.2 + 0.1 * i)
            wsD.Cells(r, 1).Value = companies(i)
            wsD.Cells(r, 2).Value = periods(j)
            wsD.Cells(r, 3).Value = Round(rev, 1)
            wsD.Cells(r, 4).Value = gm
            wsD.Cells(r, 5).Value = Round(npf, 1)
            wsD.Cells(r, 6).Value = Round(vol, 1)
        Next j
    Next i

    ' ---- 2) 格式 + 条件格式 ----
    With wsD.Range("A1:F" & r)
        .Borders.LineStyle = xlContinuous
        .Borders.Weight = xlThin
        .Font.Size = 10
    End With
    With wsD.Range("A1:F1")
        .Font.Bold = True
        .Interior.Color = RGB(31, 78, 121)
        .Font.Color = RGB(255, 255, 255)
    End With
    wsD.Range("C2:C" & r).NumberFormat = "#,##0.0"
    wsD.Range("D2:D" & r).NumberFormat = "0.0%"
    wsD.Range("D2:D" & r).FormatConditions.AddColorScale ColorScaleType:=3
    wsD.Range("A1:F1").AutoFilter
    wsD.Columns("A:F").AutoFit
    wsD.Activate
    wsD.Range("A2").Select
    ActiveWindow.FreezePanes = True

    ' ---- 3) SUMIF 汇总块（供图表）----
    wsS.Range("F2").Value = "主体"
    wsS.Range("G2").Value = "收入合计"
    For i = 0 To UBound(companies)
        wsS.Cells(3 + i, 6).Value = companies(i)
        wsS.Cells(3 + i, 7).Formula = "=SUMIF('明细数据'!$A:$A,F" & (3 + i) & ",'明细数据'!$C:$C)"
    Next i

    ' ---- 4) 透视表 ----
    Dim pc As PivotCache, pt As PivotTable
    Set pc = ThisWorkbook.PivotCaches.Create(SourceType:=xlDatabase, _
             SourceData:="明细数据!" & wsD.Range("A1:F" & r).Address)
    Set pt = pc.CreatePivotTable(TableDestination:=wsS.Range("A3"), TableName:="ptSummary")
    With pt
        .PivotFields("主体").Orientation = xlRowField
        .PivotFields("期间").Orientation = xlColumnField
        .AddDataField .PivotFields("营业收入(百万元)"), "收入合计", xlSum
    End With

    ' ---- 5) 图表 ----
    Dim ch As ChartObject
    Set ch = wsS.ChartObjects.Add(320, 250, 460, 230)
    ch.Chart.SetSourceData Source:=wsS.Range("F2:G" & (2 + UBound(companies) + 1))
    ch.Chart.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
    ch.Chart.HasTitle = True
    ch.Chart.ChartTitle.Text = "各主体营业收入合计（百万元）"

    ' ---- 6) 对账校验 + 自检指标 ----
    wsC.Range("A1").Value = "校验项"
    wsC.Range("B1").Value = "结果"
    wsC.Range("A2").Value = "数据行数"
    wsC.Range("B2").Formula = "=COUNTA('明细数据'!A2:A1000)"
    wsC.Range("A3").Value = "收入合计"
    wsC.Range("B3").Formula = "=ROUND(SUM('明细数据'!C2:C1000),1)"
    wsC.Range("A4").Value = "SUMIF对账差额"
    wsC.Range("B4").Formula = "=ROUND(SUM('明细数据'!C2:C1000)-SUM('汇总'!G3:G8),4)"
    wsC.Range("A5").Value = "毛利率区间检查"
    wsC.Range("B5").Formula = "=IF(AND(MIN('明细数据'!D2:D1000)>0.2,MAX('明细数据'!D2:D1000)<0.6),""通过"",""异常"")"
    wsC.Range("A8").Value = "工作表数"
    wsC.Range("B8").Value = ThisWorkbook.Worksheets.Count
    wsC.Range("A9").Value = "透视表数"
    wsC.Range("B9").Value = wsS.PivotTables.Count
    wsC.Range("A10").Value = "图表数"
    wsC.Range("B10").Value = wsS.ChartObjects.Count
    wsC.Range("A11").Value = "命名区域数"
    wsC.Range("B11").Value = ThisWorkbook.Names.Count

    ThisWorkbook.Names.Add Name:="收入数据", RefersTo:="='明细数据'!$C$2:$C$" & r

    Application.Calculation = xlCalculationAutomatic
    Application.CalculateFull
    wsC.Range("A6").Value = "宏耗时(秒)"
    wsC.Range("B6").Value = Round(Timer - t0, 3)
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
    wsD.Range("A1").Select
    Exit Sub
EH:
    Application.Calculation = xlCalculationAutomatic
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
    ActiveSheet.Range("Z1").Value = "ERR " & Err.Number & ": " & Err.Description
    Open LOGPATH For Append As #1
    Print #1, Format(Now, "yyyy-mm-dd hh:nn:ss") & " | BuildSummaryReport | " & Err.Number & " | " & Err.Description
    Close #1
End Sub
